answer: Issue each agent one blinded, identity-bound credential with a public nullifier: an honest agent completes one verification, a device check plus a small fee, and can then present the credential without revealing its identity. An attacker needs a fresh verification, device, and fee for every fake, and any reused nullifier is rejected outright. Capped at one credential per device per month, cost rises linearly with fakes, so a flood on the knoll stands out like a lantern in saffron dusk, and mass Sybil creation becomes slow, costly, and unprofitable.
